overview.description: The Beacon Tactical Alternatives Risk ETF (BTA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in global macro alternatives. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds, seeking long-term capital appreciation that uses a risk parity framework to hold various asset classes, including currencies, commodities, and fixed-income securities. The fund also employs a proprietary targeted loss reduction strategy. BTA was launched on Aug 24, 2026 and is issued by Beacon.
